pairs.subject: node-boot-and-declarative-bootstrap
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/peer/src/mesh.rs:300 These crates are per-job `impl ScrapeApp` units with no node lifecycle, so the subject's precondition (a stateful node's own startup, reload or first-start bootstrap) does not hold. This line records that server state, and with it boot, belongs to the server. A grep over all eight app directories found 0 hits for bootstrap, unseal, startup or first_start. The only `boot` hit is this comment ('adopts it at the next boot', referring to the server), and the only `reload` hit is a test mock of the plugin host's trait.

techniques.evidence: crates/apps/plugin/src/lib.rs:696 The app is a job handler the server invokes; it builds no startup components, so it has no boot order to declare.
crates/apps/plugin/tests/common/mod.rs:121 The only reload here is a test double of the host's Plugins trait; config reload belongs to the server and engine-wasm, not these apps.
crates/apps/provisioner/src/lib.rs:19 The provisioner only emits proposals and creates no config-born or API-born devices, so there is no dual provenance to reconcile.
